Name: SilentSmapi
Author: Denveous
Description:
[b]Ever find yourself tired of seeing the S﻿MAPI console window while playing Stardew Valley?

[/b] SilentSmapi is a simple tool that lets you run SMAPI silently in the background without drawing the window.
[b]
[b]Instructions:[/b]
[/b]
[list]
[*]Place '[b]SilentSmapi.exe[/b]' in the root of your Stardew Valley folder.
[*]Set your launch options in steam for Stardew point to the Silent Smapi executable (e.g: "f:\software\steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\SilentSmapi.exe" %command%)
[*]Run Stardew Valley and enjoy playing without the console window!
[/list][b]
[b]Virus Total Report:[/b][/b] [url=https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/febb30a9db3ffa2895f7ccbf55b60b53628f3052c997f96e0faeeda04165a04e?nocache=1]here.
[/url][b]
Possible False Positives:[/b] Some anti-virus programs may flag [b][i]SilentSmapi[/i][/b] due to it running an executable in the background. This considered is a false positive as the application is only opening [b][i]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/i][/b] without creating a window and nothing more.

[b]Source: [url=https://github.com/Denveous/SilentSmapi]https://github.com/Denveous/SilentSmapi
[/url][/b]
[b]Side note:[/b] I may upload a linux/mac version if there is any requests for it.
